text:
Priya G: Quick follow-up thread for the 22:50UTC cert rollout issue. We saw retries and TLS failures in a small window due to routing entries not being invalidated after cert bind updates.
Markus V: Timeline was ~22:49-22:57 UTC. Mostly na-central -> ap-northeast1. RouteSet-D sticky entries held on to old backend IPs.
Ivy N: Triage: bind update finished before cache invalidation for a subset of hosts; probes showed cert mismatch on ~2% of connections, clients retried and fell back to slower paths.
Priya G: Proposed immediate actions: 1) emergency invalidate RouteSet-D caches, 2) add pre-rollout parity check between bind API and LB maps, 3) instrument metric for tls.bind_mismatch and alert, 4) create ticket for recurring pattern review.
Markus V: I'll do #1 and add the exact invalidation command to Runbooks: `./scripts/invalidate-lb --routeset routeset-d --force`. ETA: 2h.
Ivy N: I'll own #2 and #3. CI parity check will compare binds vs maps and fail rollout if divergence >1 entry. Metric PR coming in by EOD.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: cert-verify-routeset-d-2026-04-05-00:30 (ap-northeast1). Results will be posted here.
SRE Oncall: Manual checks if needed:
```
dig +short api.routeset-d.redwood.internal A @ns1.ap-northeast1
curl -v --resolve api.routeset-d.redwood.internal:443:198.51.100.42 https://api.routeset-d.redwood.internal/health
```
Priya G: Owners recap:
- Markus V: emergency invalidate + runbook update — 2h
- Ivy N: CI parity checks + tls.bind_mismatch metric — EOD
- SRE Oncall: monitor canary and metric for 72h
Markus V: Pushed runbook snippet and the invalidate command. Will coordinate rollback steps if canary shows regressions.
Ivy N: Created NET-507: "routeset-d bind vs map parity and recurring analysis" and added a 6-week review cadence. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-507
Priya G: Thanks all. Reopen if anything odd shows up; otherwise we'll close in 48h after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
